mongodb_uri.description: MongoDB connection URI. Required. Supports formats like mongodb://user:pass@host:27017, mongodb+srv://... for Atlas, and replica set connection strings (mongodb://host1,host2/...?replicaSet=rs0).

mongodb_db.description: Database to query for database-level metrics (e.g., dbStats). Set to 'all' to scan all databases (⚠️ not recommended for production due to performance impact).

disabled_metrics.description: List of metric categories to disable. Valid options: collection, index, dbstats, replset, sharded, diagnostics, serverstatus, top.

enable_diagnostics.description: Enable collection of diagnostics data (e.g., diagnostics collections in admin database). Requires MongoDB 4.2+.

metrics_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each MongoDB query. Increase if queries time out on slow clusters.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the connection to MongoDB.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate file. Required if TLS is enabled and using a self-signed or non-public CA certificate.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS (optional).

tls_key_file.description: Path to client private key file (for TLS client auth).

tls_insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (⚠️ insecure, for testing only). Do not use in production.

web_listen_address.description: Address and port to expose the exporter metrics endpoint.

mongodb_user.description: MongoDB username. Use only if not embedded in mongodb_uri.

mongodb_password.description: MongoDB password (will be stored in plaintext). Use only if not embedded in mongodb_uri.

mongodb_auth_db.description: MongoDB authentication database. Default is 'admin' for most deployments.

collect_hidden.description: Collect metrics from hidden replica set members (e.g., for backup nodes).

secondary_only.description: Only collect metrics from secondary nodes (skip the primary). Useful for read-only monitoring.

extra_labels.description: List of key-value pairs to attach as labels to all metrics (e.g., environment, region). Format as a list of objects with 'key' and 'value'.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections to the MongoDB server. Adjust based on your MongoDB's connection limits.

enable_profiling.description: Collect metrics from MongoDB's profiler (requires profiling level > 0).
